query: What is the penalty for a defensive three-second violation in the NBA?
english_query: What is the penalty for a defensive three-second violation in the NBA?
ground_truth_answer: In the NBA, the penalty for a defensive three-second violation is a technical foul. The offensive team is awarded one free throw, which can be shot by any player in the game, and the offensive team retains possession of the ball.

query: bro show me the exact hand signal the ref makes for a traveling violation in FIBA
english_query: Show me the exact hand signal the referee makes for a traveling violation in FIBA.
ground_truth_answer: In FIBA, the referee signals a traveling violation by rotating their fists around each other in front of their chest.

query: How long is an overtime period in NCAA men's basketball?
english_query: How long is an overtime period in NCAA men's basketball?
ground_truth_answer: In NCAA men's basketball, each overtime (extra period) is five minutes long.

query: How does the scoring system work in FIBA 3x3? Is there a 3-point line?
english_query: How does the scoring system work in FIBA 3x3? Is there a 3-point line?
ground_truth_answer: In FIBA 3x3, shots made inside the arc and free throws are worth 1 point. Shots made from outside the arc are worth 2 points. There are no 3-point shots.

query: ¿Cuáles son las medidas exactas de la pista y la línea de tres puntos en la NBA? Enséñame el diagrama.
english_query: What are the exact dimensions of the court and the three-point line in the NBA? Show me the diagram.
ground_truth_answer: La pista de la NBA mide 94 pies de largo por 50 pies de ancho. La línea de tres puntos está a 23 pies y 9 pulgadas de la canasta en la parte superior del arco, y a 22 pies en las esquinas.

query: En FIBA, est-ce que frapper la planche compte comme une interférence de panier?
english_query: In FIBA, does hitting the backboard count as basket interference?
ground_truth_answer: En FIBA, frapper la planche (backboard) ne compte comme interférence de panier que si cela fait vibrer le panier de manière à empêcher le ballon d'entrer ou de modifier sa trajectoire de façon décisive.

query: What's the difference between a 1-and-1 and the double bonus in NCAA?
english_query: What's the difference between a 1-and-1 and the double bonus in NCAA?
ground_truth_answer: In NCAA, the 1-and-1 bonus begins on the 7th team foul of the half, where the shooter must make the first free throw to earn the second. The double bonus begins on the 10th team foul, guaranteeing two free throws regardless of whether the first is made.

query: ¿Quién tiene la primera posesión en un partido de 3x3?
english_query: Who gets the first possession in a 3x3 game?
ground_truth_answer: En FIBA 3x3, el equipo que gana el lanzamiento de moneda (coin flip) antes del partido puede elegir tener la primera posesión al inicio del partido o la primera posesión en caso de un posible tiempo extra (overtime).

query: explain the hand signal for an unsportsmanlike foul in fiba please i need a pic too
english_query: Explain the hand signal for an unsportsmanlike foul in FIBA and provide a picture.
ground_truth_answer: In FIBA, the referee signals an unsportsmanlike foul by grasping their wrist with the other hand above their head.

query: In FIBA, what does the shot clock reset to after an offensive rebound?
english_query: In FIBA, what does the shot clock reset to after an offensive rebound?
ground_truth_answer: In FIBA, if the offensive team recovers the rebound after a missed shot that touched the rim, the shot clock is reset to 14 seconds, not 24.

query: Can a player be subbed in between the first and second free throw in the NBA?
english_query: Can a player be subbed in between the first and second free throw in the NBA?
ground_truth_answer: In the NBA, substitutions are generally not allowed between multiple free throw attempts unless a substitution is necessitated by an injury or an ejection.

query: bruh what is the restricted area arc for in college hoops?
english_query: What is the restricted area arc used for in NCAA basketball?
ground_truth_answer: In the NCAA, the restricted area arc prevents secondary defenders from taking a charge underneath the basket. If a secondary defender is inside or on the line of the restricted area, a charging foul cannot be called on the offensive player.

query: how do u 'check the ball' in 3x3? what are the exact rules for starting play?
english_query: How do you check the ball in 3x3 basketball and what are the rules for starting play?
ground_truth_answer: In FIBA 3x3, the ball must be 'checked' (exchanged between the defensive and offensive player) behind the arc at the top of the court before play can begin after every dead ball.

query: Comment les arbitres signalent-ils un passage en force (foul by team in control of the ball) en FIBA ? Montrez-moi l'image.
english_query: How do referees signal a player control foul (charge) in FIBA? Show me the image.
ground_truth_answer: En FIBA, pour signaler une faute d'un joueur dont l'équipe contrôle le ballon (souvent un passage en force), l'arbitre donne un coup de poing dans la paume de son autre main.

query: When can a team advance the ball to half court using a timeout in the NBA?
english_query: When can a team advance the ball to half court using a timeout in the NBA?
ground_truth_answer: In the NBA, a team can advance the ball to the frontcourt if they call a timeout in the last two minutes of the fourth quarter or the last two minutes of any overtime period.

query: If there's no shot clock visible in a pickup 3x3 game, what is the stalling rule?
english_query: If there is no physical shot clock in FIBA 3x3, what is the passivity or stalling rule?
ground_truth_answer: If there is no physical shot clock in a 3x3 game, stalling or failing to play actively is a violation. The referee shall warn the team by counting down the last 5 seconds.

query: yo where exactly is the coaching box marked on an NCAA court? need the layout
english_query: Where is the coaching box marked on an NCAA basketball court? I need the layout.
ground_truth_answer: In the NCAA, the coaching box is marked outside the sideline, beginning 38 feet from the end line and extending towards the end line. A diagram shows it designated by two lines perpendicular to the sideline.

query: Combien de fautes d'équipe par quart-temps avant les lancers francs en FIBA?
english_query: How many team fouls per quarter before the penalty free throws in FIBA?
ground_truth_answer: En FIBA, une équipe est dans la pénalité de fautes d'équipe lorsqu'elle a commis 4 fautes d'équipe dans un quart-temps. À partir de la 5ème faute d'équipe, chaque faute défensive personnelle entraîne deux lancers francs.

query: What is the radius of the restricted area in the NBA?
english_query: What is the radius of the restricted area in the NBA?
ground_truth_answer: In the NBA, the restricted area is a semi-circle with a radius of 4 feet measured from the center of the basket.

query: How does a team win a FIBA 3x3 game? Is it by points or time?
english_query: How does a team win a FIBA 3x3 game? Is it by points or time?
ground_truth_answer: In FIBA 3x3, the first team to score 21 points or more wins the game if it happens before the end of regular playing time. Otherwise, the team leading at the end of the 10-minute playing time wins.
